verdict.rationale: Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU and NPU silicon). Choosing a data storage region or residency is a cloud/SaaS service axis, not a capability a chip ships, so the story is a category error for this product type. The evidence describes on-device AI and a developer toolchain but nothing about selectable storage regions. The cloud-hosted device profiling mentioned for Qualcomm AI Hub is a separate developer service with no residency controls described, so it does not make the axis applicable.
